description:
Connor McDavid continues to cement his legacy among the game’s all-time greats, now becoming just the fourth player in NHL history to win six or more Art Ross Trophy titles. Already in elite company as one of only nine players to capture three or more Hart Trophies, his dominance shows no signs of slowing. Perhaps the most explosive offensive force of his generation, McDavid blends breathtaking speed, impossible edgework, and world-class puck skill to take over games in ways few defenders can contain. 
A constant MVP threat, he drives play at an elite level while delivering both dazzling goals and prolific playmaking. One of his many electrifying moments came at home in Edmonton against Columbus, when McDavid spun his way to an unreal third-period goal to pull the Oilers within one and spark the comeback. He struck again later in the period, and Edmonton completed the rally with an overtime win."A constant MVP threat, he drives play at an elite level while delivering both dazzling goals and prolific playmaking.
